scripts.build: pnpm --filter @smshop/db build && pnpm --filter @smshop/api build && pnpm --filter @smshop/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @smshop/db build && pnpm --filter @smshop/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @smshop/web typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @smshop/db lint && pnpm --filter @smshop/api lint && pnpm --filter @smshop/web lint
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.verify:ci: pnpm db:test:migrate && pnpm verify && pnpm test:db
